title: Funnel & Profit Leaks
description: Identify profit leaks across your customer journey — conversion gaps, response delays, and funnel stages that bleed margin.

faq.a: A profit leak is revenue you almost captured but lost due to a broken funnel stage — slow response, weak conversion, or customers who never buy again.

faq.q: Where should I look first for funnel leaks?
faq.a: Measure conversion between each step (visit → lead → sale → repeat). The largest gap vs benchmark is usually your highest-impact leak.

intro: Profit leaks hide between funnel stages. These articles show how to find them with rough math and benchmarks — no finance team required.
